skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding basic knowledge about WTO organization and activities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic knowledge about the organization and activities of the World Trade Organization (WTO), its establishment and development, principles of operation, multilateral and plurilateral agreements, and WTO agreements on goods trade, services trade, and intellectual property rights.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding dispute resolution mechanisms of WTO
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic knowledge about the dispute resolution mechanisms of the World Trade Organization (WTO).
Develop self-study skills to accumulate and enhance knowledge.
Be proactive in presenting research results.
